Name: Sakura Interface
Author: eyeyumi
Description:
**PLEASE READ BEFORE DOWNLOADING**

UPDATE!!: So, I am happy to say that this mod has been fixed and updated with the credit due to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53724786]TheFrenchDodo[/url]! 
Again, this version has a couple issues with the UI, so make sure to download  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url] by TheFrenchDodo if you are considering this mod.
TheFrenchDodo's version fixes these issues and provides other options in the interface. 


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you have any issues or suggestions, I will try to help the best I can. I am still fairly new and made this for fun. 
There may be additions for this Sakura Interface in the future. I have not had much time to actually play Stardew, so I know I covered the majority of the interface. 

Again, this Sakura Interface includes my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10488]Sakura Cursors[/url]﻿. If I need to upload a file that does not include Sakura Cursors, let me know. :) I'm not sure if it interferes with other Cursor mods. 

I do not currently have a list with what shaders this interface is compatible with. ﻿So, if something looks funky it may be because of the shader or retexture. I know that the Wittily Named Recolor is compatible, since that is what I'm using. 

Mods used in pictures: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8361]Shie's Portraits[/url]﻿
Font Attribute https://m.blog.naver.com/khs3400/222049471897 (I did not have to make an account for naver) 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11040]Script Font[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]Wittily Named Recolor
[/url]Eemie's Victorian Buildings ﻿https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580707-eemies-victorian-buildings-for-cp
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10035]Lux's Food Mod

[/url]SMAPI is required and this mod should work with Content Patcher. 

I would [b]really[/b] recommend using the [b]Font Attribute[/b] mod. Sadly, I do not think this one is on Nexus Mods. 
My little instructions for installing this mod would be to first, copy and paste that link. (Let me know if link doesn't work too pls)
It should bring you to Naver cafe under Jin's blog. 
If you scroll down the page, you should see a download file called FixFontOption 1.1.7.zip
That is the Font Attribute mod. 
Hopefully that can make it somewhat easier for downloading from Naver cafe.

Thanks again for trying out! Hope you enjoy~
